name: 复制状态变量监控诊断
description: MySQL 复制监控涉及两种方式：传统 SHOW REPLICA STATUS 命令和 performance_schema 复制表。核心监控指标包括：IO/SQL 线程运行状态、Seconds_Behind_Source（复制延迟）、GTID 执行集合差异、Relay_Log_Space（中继日志空间）。传统方式返回单行多列，P_S 表更结构化且支持 SQL 查询。生产环境应同时监控 IO 延迟和 SQL 延迟。

skip_when.desc: 延迟复制，延迟是配置预期

root_causes.name: SQL 线程回放慢
root_causes.desc: Seconds_Behind_Source 持续增长，IO 线程正常但 SQL 线程回放速度跟不上主库写入速度。常见原因：未启用并行复制、大事务串行回放、从库 IO 瓶颈。

root_causes.name: IO 线程落后或断开
root_causes.desc: IO 线程断开（网络问题、主库重启、binlog 被 purge）或延迟接收 binlog。表现为 Master_Log_File != Relay_Master_Log_File 或 IO 线程 SERVICE_STATE=OFF。

root_causes.name: GTID 集合不一致
root_causes.desc: 从库的 gtid_executed 与主库存在差异（缺少某些 GTID 或包含额外的 GTID）。可能导致主从切换时数据不一致。

root_causes.name: 监控指标解读错误
root_causes.desc: Seconds_Behind_Source 的计算方式有局限：基于事件时间戳而非实时差异。IO 线程断开时该值为 NULL 而非大数值。从库时钟偏移也会影响准确性。

step1_show_replica_status.desc: 完整复制状态（传统方式）

step2_ps_connection.desc: P_S 方式查看 IO 线程状态
step2_ps_connection.sql: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, SOURCE_UUID, SERVICE_STATE, RECEIVED_TRANSACTION_SET, LAST_ERROR_NUMBER, LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE, LAST_HEARTBEAT_TIMESTAMP FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_status

step3_ps_applier.desc: P_S 方式查看 SQL 线程状态
step3_ps_applier.sql: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, SERVICE_STATE, REMAINING_DELAY, COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_RETRIES FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status

step4_gtid_comparison.desc: 查看 GTID 执行集合用于主从对比
step4_gtid_comparison.sql: SELECT @@server_uuid AS server_uuid, @@gtid_executed AS gtid_executed, @@gtid_purged AS gtid_purged, @@gtid_mode AS gtid_mode

step5_relay_log_space.desc: 检查中继日志空间使用
step5_relay_log_space.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Relay_log_space')
step5_relay_log_space.note: 也可在 SHOW REPLICA STATUS 中查看 Relay_Log_Space

step6_replication_lag_precise.desc: 精确计算 IO 延迟 vs SQL 延迟
step6_replication_lag_precise.sql: SELECT c.CHANNEL_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.LAST_QUEUED_TRANSACTION_END_QUEUE_TIMESTAMP, NOW()) AS io_lag_sec, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, w.LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP, NOW()) AS sql_lag_sec FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_status c JOIN (SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, MAX(LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP) AS LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_worker WHERE LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION != '' GROUP BY CHANNEL_NAME) w ON c.CHANNEL_NAME = w.CHANNEL_NAME

emergency_playbook.scenario: 复制延迟持续增长且不收敛

steps.action: 检查是否有大事务阻塞
steps.sql: SELECT WORKER_ID, APPLYING_TRANSACTION FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_worker WHERE SERVICE_STATE = 'ON'

steps.action: 如果未启用并行复制，立即开启
steps.sql: STOP REPLICA; SET GLOBAL replica_parallel_workers = 16; SET GLOBAL replica_parallel_type = 'LOGICAL_CLOCK'; START REPLICA

version_specific_notes.5.7: 使用 SHOW SLAVE STATUS。P_S 复制表可用但字段较少。Seconds_Behind_Master 可能因时钟偏移不准确
version_specific_notes.8.0: 使用 SHOW REPLICA STATUS。P_S 表完整支持 GTID 时间戳精确延迟计算。8.0.22+ 新增 COUNT_TRANSACTIONS_RETRIES
version_specific_notes.8.4: SHOW SLAVE STATUS 完全移除。P_S 复制表是唯一标准接口。延迟计算精度进一步提升

real_world_examples.scenario: Seconds_Behind_Master 显示 0 但数据实际延迟 5 分钟
real_world_examples.symptoms: SHOW SLAVE STATUS 显示 Seconds_Behind_Master = 0，但查询从库数据比主库旧 5 分钟
real_world_examples.root_cause: IO 线程断开后重连，Seconds_Behind_Master 重置为 0 但实际有大量 relay log 未回放
real_world_examples.resolution: 改用 P_S 表的 GTID 时间戳计算精确延迟
real_world_examples.result: 精确发现 SQL 延迟 5 分钟，通过增加 Worker 解决
